description: This is a shell script that automates release version bumping for a software project. It analyzes git commits and PR labels to determine version increments and optionally updates metadata.yaml files in various components. It supports flags for applying changes, running in dry-run mode, and customizing its behavior based on commit history and labels.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits the script.

methods.name: get_pr_for_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the PR number associated with a commit, using cached data or GitHub API.

methods.name: get_pr_labels
methods.description: Retrieves labels associated with a PR from GitHub, with caching.

methods.name: component_from_path
methods.description: Determines the component directory for a given file path based on existing component metadata directories.

methods.name: is_doc_like_path
methods.description: Checks if a file path is documentation-like or metadata-related based on filename patterns.

methods.name: compute_next_versions
methods.description: Calculates the next version and generation numbers based on current data and bump type.

methods.name: update_metadata
methods.description: Updates the version and generation in a component's metadata.yaml file.
